title: A run hidden by a condition
concept: A CharacterStyleRange that names a hidden Condition via AppliedConditions is dropped before layout — the parser reads two runs, the renderer lays out one.

annotations.note: The first run carries no AppliedConditions, so it is always laid out.
The second run names Condition/Draft via AppliedConditions — a space-separated list of Condition references.
Condition/Draft is declared Visible="false" in Resources/Styles.xml, so the renderer drops this whole run before layout. The page shows only the first run.
